title: Electrically Reconfigurable Silicon Carbide Nanophotonic Cavities on Thin-Film Lithium Niobate
summary: Interfacing integrated photonics with solid-state spin defects holds great promise for future quantum networks, but the scaling of spin-photon architectures is hindered by frequency mismatches arising from fabrication-induced variations in photonic cavity resonances and the inhomogeneous optical transition frequencies of individual spins. These challenges call for a photonic platform with deterministic and wide-range tunability.
